# Procedure

Discover actual Spring version and filter/bean wiring. Trace authentication, URL/method authorisation, session and role mapping. Preserve container/application responsibility. Include positive and denied endpoint tests; hiding a button is not enforcement. Never widen a role to make tests pass.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
